event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,578 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 66 prior macro-attempts in this family and 561 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0168/micro-0004 at 1,586 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0168/micro-0005 (FF-output pair 183/223 discarded at 98.99%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 71 and 92, values -0.0016995448 and -0.0014201598 (difference 2.794e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,577 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 2.814e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
